table.title: 都道府県の人口一覧（国勢調査、上位11）
table.edits:
first 12 rows (全国 + ranks 1–11); flag images omitted;
as published

conditions.browser: Chromium (Playwright build), macOS system fonts, deviceScaleFactor 1

candidates.name: s2B
candidates.idea: Refine P by extending the first two year columns so the first four columns total 359px. This may align the initial viewport with a column boundary while retaining P's coherent headers and intact figures.
candidates.label: gold

whys: Whole figures and names, clear year groupings and consistent rows support reading. The first viewport contains the labels and two recent years; older-year comparisons still require substantial scrolling.

Names and figures remain whole, with clear two-line year headers and consistent rows. The first two year columns have a little more breathing room than in A, while both remain visible initially; older years still require substantial scrolling.

Whole names and figures, consistent year headings, and slightly more room in the first two year columns make this easy to scan. The first viewport shows the identifiers and two recent years; distant-year comparisons still require substantial scrolling.

candidates.name: d1r0B
candidates.idea: 各列に最長の一行内容と余白を収める幅を与え、横スクロールで人口値と見出しを途切れず読めるようにする。
candidates.label: gold

whys: Prefecture names and population figures remain whole, and year headers break naturally. The first viewport shows the labels and two recent years, though comparing older years requires substantial horizontal scrolling.

Prefecture names and population figures remain whole, and the year headers break naturally. The initial viewport shows the identifiers and two complete years; comparing older years requires substantial scrolling.

Prefecture names and population figures remain whole, and the two-line year headings are consistent. The initial viewport shows the identifiers and two recent years, though comparing distant years requires substantial scrolling and the row labels move offscreen.

candidates.name: contrast
candidates.idea: This 359px layout fits the viewport but leaves only 9px of text space in each year column after padding and borders. Figures and dates would fragment severely, and even the rank and prefecture columns would be cramped.
candidates.label: bad

whys: The wider prefecture column helps somewhat, but names still break and the population figures and year headers remain fragmented into character stacks. Lookup is very difficult and horizontal scrolling is still needed.

Population figures and year labels fragment into long stacks of digits, making lookup and comparison extremely difficult. Prefecture names also wrap, and the table still requires horizontal scrolling.

Population figures and years fragment into long stacks of digits, making comparison extremely difficult. Prefecture names also break across lines, and the tall rows disrupt scanning despite requiring horizontal scrolling.
Population figures stay on one line, but prefecture names stack character by character and era labels break awkwardly. The narrow label columns produce tall, sparse rows and hinder locating places.

Population figures stay whole, but prefecture names stack one character per line and era labels break awkwardly. The resulting tall rows add large empty areas and slow lookup, while the table still requires considerable scrolling.

Population figures stay whole, but the prefecture column forces names into single-character lines and year headings split awkwardly. The narrow label column inflates rows and leaves large empty areas, making lookup and comparison laborious.
Headers, names and population figures fragment into narrow stacks of characters. Tall rows make lookup and comparison extremely difficult, yet the table still requires horizontal scrolling.

The narrow columns break almost every figure and header into vertical fragments; prefecture names and some codes are also split. Tall rows make scanning arduous, despite the table still extending beyond the viewport.

Years, population figures, prefecture names and some codes break into isolated characters or digit fragments. The resulting tall, dense grid is exceptionally hard to use and still requires horizontal scrolling.

d1.purpose: 国勢調査の人口について、全国と人口上位11都道府県を複数年にわたって参照する。
tasks: 順位や都道府県名から行を探し、特定年の人口を調べる。
同じ年の都道府県間の人口を比較する。
同じ都道府県の人口を年を追って比較し、全国の推移と照らす。
relations: 順位は2025年の人口順を示し、全国は順位0の基準行として置かれている。
都道府県コードと名称は同じ地域を識別する。
各年の列は同じ人口指標を新しい年から古い年へ並べ、見出しには西暦と対応する元号年がある。
roles: 先頭列は順位、2列目は地域の識別子、残る9列は年別人口である。
最上段は列見出し、全国行は集計の基準、残る11行は都道府県の観測値である。
keep_whole: 都道府県名と各人口値は検索や比較のため、可能な限り分割しない。
西暦と元号年はそれぞれひとまとまりとして読めることが望ましい。
may_wrap: 都道府県コードと名称の間。
年見出しの西暦と括弧付き元号年の間。
画面幅に収める案では人口値や見出しの途中の分割も避けられず、読み取りを大きく損なう。
same_scale: 年別人口の列は同じ役割なので、値を保てる範囲で近い幅にする。
順位列は短く、都道府県列は名称を収める幅を優先する。
d1.h_vs_v: 人口値を一行に保つには横スクロールが必要だが、行の高さを抑え、年や地域の比較がしやすい。画面内に収めると全列の存在は一望できる一方、数字と見出しが細かく分断され、表が極端に縦長になる。

d2.purpose: 国勢調査における人口上位の都道府県を、全国値とともに複数年にわたって比較する。
tasks: 順位から都道府県を探す
特定の年の人口を読み取る
同じ都道府県の人口の推移を追う
都道府県間や全国値と比較する
relations: 各行は一つの地域を表し、年次列は新しい年から古い年へ並ぶ。
全国の行は都道府県の順位とは異なる比較基準である。
都道府県コードと名称は同じ地域を識別する組である。
roles: 先頭列は順位、次列は地域の識別子、残る9列は各年の人口である。
列見出しの西暦と元号は同じ調査年を示す。
全国行に続いて、2025年の人口順位に沿った11都道府県が並ぶ。
keep_whole: 人口の数値と桁区切り
順位と都道府県コード
西暦および元号のそれぞれの年表記
may_wrap: 年見出しは西暦と括弧内の元号の間で折り返せる。
都道府県コードと名称は別の行に置ける。
画面内に収める案では、人口や年表記の分割が避けられない。
same_scale: 年次列は同じ種類の数値を比較するため、おおむね同じ幅が望ましい。
順位列は短く、地域列は名称を収める幅が必要である。
d2.h_vs_v: 画面内に全列を収めると数値や年表記が細かく分割され、行が高くなり比較も難しくなる。横スクロールを使えば情報をほぼ一行に保てるが、初期表示で見える年が限られ、過去年との比較にはスクロールが必要になる。

d3.purpose: 国勢調査の人口を都道府県別・調査年別に一覧し、上位11都道府県の順位と長期的な変化を示す。
tasks: 順位や都道府県名から行を探す。
同じ年の都道府県間の人口を比較する。
一つの都道府県の人口を年代に沿って追う。
全国の人口と各都道府県の人口を参照する。
relations: 各人口値は同じ行の地域と同じ列の調査年に対応する。
全国は比較のための集計行で、順位付きの都道府県とは役割が異なる。
都道府県コードと名称は同じ地域を識別する。
西暦と元号表記は同じ調査年を示す。
roles: 先頭列は順位、2列目は地域の識別に使う。
残りの9列は新しい年から古い年へ並ぶ人口値で、各列見出しが調査年を示す。
最初のデータ行は全国、続く11行は都道府県である。
keep_whole: 都道府県名と2桁の都道府県コードそれぞれ
西暦年と、括弧を含む元号年それぞれ
may_wrap: 都道府県コードと名称の間
年見出しの西暦年と元号表記の間
画面内に収める案では、人口値や年表記も分割せざるを得ず、読解と比較が難しくなる。
same_scale: 人口を示す9列は同じ役割を持つため、内容が収まる範囲で近い幅にする。
順位列は短く、地域列は名称を保てる幅にする。
d3.h_vs_v: 横スクロールを使えば人口値を一行に保ち、行を追いやすくできるが、古い年を見るには移動が必要になる。画面内に収めると全列の位置関係は見える一方、数値と見出しが細かく分割され、行が高くなって比較しにくい。

analysis.strengths: All characters and population figures are visible, with no measured breaks inside words. Prefecture names remain intact, and the year headings break consistently between the Western year and Japanese era. The initial viewport shows rank, prefecture and two complete recent census columns, supporting current comparisons.
analysis.faults: The table requires substantial horizontal scrolling. Later years are separated from their prefecture labels when scrolled into view, making row tracking harder. Several year columns are wider than needed to keep their values intact, adding to the scrolling distance. The two-line prefecture entries make most rows tall, leaving considerable blank space beneath the population figures.
analysis.spatial_logic: Rank and prefecture receive compact widths, while each census column is sized near its widest one-line content. This preserves population figures and allows the year headings to occupy two lines, prioritizing legibility over a compact table.

rounds.insights: Only one layout is shown, so there is no direct comparison between alternatives. The main tradeoff is between keeping census figures whole and fitting all eleven columns on a phone. A scrolling layout can show two recent years alongside the prefecture labels at first sight; a fitted layout must split both headings and numbers severely and is likely much harder to use. The prefecture code and name already occupy two lines, so modestly reducing year-column widths need not increase body-row height if all figures remain whole.

analysis.strengths: The rank column is legible, and the table needs less horizontal scrolling than P.
analysis.faults: Population figures and dates break into fragments, making lookup and comparison extremely difficult. Some prefecture names also wrap. The table is very tall despite still requiring horizontal scrolling.
analysis.spatial_logic: Narrow year columns spread each record over many lines, so the apparent gain in width comes at a severe cost to vertical continuity.

analysis.strengths: Population figures remain whole, prefecture names are readable, and the consistent two-line date headers make the chronology easy to scan. The initial viewport shows rank, prefecture and two complete recent census columns.
analysis.faults: The historical columns require substantial horizontal scrolling, and the identifying columns disappear when the reader scrolls away from them. The partial next column at the viewport edge is visible but cannot yet be read in full.
analysis.spatial_logic: The width supports intact values and a compact, regular row rhythm. Two-line prefecture labels set the height of most rows, leaving useful space around the figures.

rounds.insights: For this table, preserving whole population figures is much more valuable than squeezing more fragmented columns into the phone viewport. P is the clear scrolling choice so far. A viewport-fitting design necessarily forces severe breaks across the nine year columns, but should still be tested as a separate class.

analysis.strengths: The rank and prefecture columns remain recognizable, and several years appear in the initial viewport.
analysis.faults: Population figures and year labels fragment into individual digits and short pieces. The prefecture names also break unnaturally, making lookup and comparison extremely difficult despite horizontal scrolling.
analysis.spatial_logic: Narrow year columns produce an exceptionally tall table; the modest reduction in horizontal extent comes at a severe cost to continuous reading.

analysis.strengths: Population figures remain whole, prefecture names are legible, and the first two census years are visible alongside the identifying columns.
analysis.faults: Several era labels break across three lines, separating 年 and closing punctuation from the rest of the label. Historical comparisons require substantial horizontal scrolling.
analysis.spatial_logic: Widths close to the minimum for intact numbers keep the table relatively compact horizontally, but some headers need more space than the numbers.

analysis.strengths: Figures stay intact and all year headers resolve into two coherent lines. The initial viewport supports comparison of 2025 and 2020 with rank and prefecture visible.
analysis.faults: The table requires extensive horizontal scrolling, and the initial viewport cuts into the next column. Row identifiers leave the viewport when scrolling unless the surrounding interface provides a way to retain them.
analysis.spatial_logic: Extra width is concentrated in years with longer era labels, producing a consistent header height and a calm, regular body without widening every column equally.

rounds.insights: The year columns need enough width for both whole population figures and coherent era labels. P demonstrates that a small increase over s1B can improve header rhythm without increasing body height. A viewport-fitting alternative necessarily fragments figures heavily at the fixed font and padding; it should be judged separately from the scrolling layouts.

analysis.strengths: All population figures and prefecture names remain intact. The two-line year headings are consistent, and the initial viewport shows rank, prefecture, 2025 and 2020 completely.
analysis.faults: The table requires substantial horizontal scrolling. Once the reader moves to older years, the prefecture identifiers leave the viewport.
analysis.spatial_logic: The first four columns use the viewport almost exactly. The wider historical columns accommodate their longer era labels and figures without forcing additional lines.

analysis.strengths: It preserves the same readable content and row rhythm as s2B while reducing total width by 10px. Both recent census columns remain fully readable at first sight.
analysis.faults: The small width saving does little to reduce scrolling. The viewport ends just inside the 2015 column, exposing a narrow, incomplete sliver.
analysis.spatial_logic: The narrower 2025 and 2020 columns still accommodate their contents, but shift the next column across the viewport edge. The remaining column widths follow the same content-based pattern as s2B.

rounds.insights: Both scrolling layouts preserve the units that matter for lookup and comparison. s2B has the cleaner initial viewport because its edge coincides with the end of 2020; P's small reduction in total width does not materially change the scrolling task. A 359px fit requires a separate, much denser compromise that will split population figures and year labels.

bad.why: Population figures and year labels break across many lines, making lookup and comparison difficult. It also still requires horizontal scrolling.

contrast.why: This 359px layout fits the viewport but leaves only 9px of text space in each year column after padding and borders. Figures and dates would fragment severely, and even the rank and prefecture columns would be cramped.

sameFunctionGroups.why: All nine columns contain comparable census populations. Similar widths support scanning, with small differences justified by the space needed for complete values and readable year labels.
Rank is a short lookup key and does not need the scale of a population column.
The prefecture identifier and name need a width suited to Japanese labels, distinct from both rank and numeric values.

synthesis.rationale: s2B keeps the population figures intact and the year headings to two lines, while its initial viewport shows the rank, prefecture and two recent censuses cleanly. Layout P achieves nearly the same result, but exposes a narrow fragment of the next column at the viewport edge. s1B saves some horizontal travel, though several era labels break awkwardly onto a third line. No supplied candidate fits within 359px, so there is no rendered fitting layout to submit as a finalist.

general: Keep identifiers, numbers and meaningful label units together when their integrity supports lookup.
Give columns with the same function a consistent visual scale while allowing for differences in content.
Judge a scrolling table both as a whole and at its initial viewport.
specific: The first two census years fit alongside rank and prefecture in the initial viewport of s2B.
At this font size and padding, fitting all nine census columns within 359px would force severe fragmentation.

synthesis.tradeoffs: s2B requires substantial horizontal scrolling, and prefecture labels leave the viewport when the reader moves to older years. s1B reduces the table width by 72px but makes several headings taller and less natural to read.
synthesis.uncertain: No fitting candidate was rendered, so a best-fitting design cannot be selected from the supplied evidence. Sticky columns or other interaction changes are outside the permitted width-only adjustments.

critique.good: The region column remains identifiable in most rows, and several year columns are visible at first sight.
critique.problems: Population values and year headings break into fragments, making lookup and comparison extremely difficult. The table is exceptionally tall yet still requires horizontal scrolling. The rank and prefecture headings also wrap, and 神奈川県 breaks across lines.
critique.cause: All nine year columns are only 38px wide; the 45px rank column and 68px region column are also too narrow for their headings or longest names.

critique.good: Population values and era years remain whole. The two-line year headings are consistent, and the first viewport shows the identifiers and two complete recent years. The full table has clear, regular column and row groupings.
critique.problems: Most prefecture rows are tall because the code and name occupy separate lines. Later years require substantial scrolling, during which the region identifiers move out of view.
critique.cause: The 83px region column fits the heading and names but wraps the combined code and name. Year columns of 107–117px preserve readable content at the cost of a 1145px table.

critique.good: Population values remain whole, and the first viewport still presents the identifiers and two recent years clearly. The table is narrower than B.
critique.problems: Several era labels break before 年） and force a three-line header, disrupting the otherwise regular hierarchy. The saved width does not improve the initial viewport, while the table becomes taller.
critique.cause: The reduced widths of 96–106px in the later year columns are insufficient for their complete parenthesized era labels.

critique.good: 順位、地域名、人口値を読みやすく保ち、年見出しも西暦と元号年の自然な二行に収まっている。行の高さも揃い、年ごとの比較がしやすい。
critique.problems: 初期画面では2020年列の右端が切れ、値を読み切るにはスクロールが必要。地域列には余白が多い。
critique.cause: 地域列が110pxあるため、順位列と合わせて162pxを占め、2020年列の右端が表示領域を超える。

critique.good: 複数の年が初期画面に現れ、横方向の移動量自体は小さい。
critique.problems: 人口値、年見出し、地域名が細かく分断され、検索も比較も困難。行が極端に高く、それでも全列は画面内に収まっていない。
critique.cause: 年列の38pxでは、パディングと罫線を除く文字領域が約17pxしかない。地域列48pxも名称を保つには不足する。指定幅は最小幅に引き上げられ、表全体は429pxになっている。

critique.good: 地域名と人口値を保ち、年見出しを自然な二行に分けている。初期画面に順位、地域、2025年と2020年の値が収まり、最近の二時点をすぐ比較できる。
critique.problems: 古い年を見るには大きく横スクロールする必要があり、スクロール先では地域の識別子が画面外になる。初期画面の右端には次の列の一部だけが見える。
critique.cause: 地域列83pxと各年列107〜117pxは内容を保つ一方、表全体を1145pxにする。列幅の変更だけでは、スクロール中に識別列を固定できない。

critique.good: Most columns are visible at first sight, and the rank column remains identifiable.
critique.problems: Population values, years and prefecture names fragment into narrow vertical stacks. Rows become extremely tall, making lookup and comparison impractical, while horizontal scrolling is still required.
critique.cause: The 38–40 px columns leave only 17–19 px for text. The enforced 38 px minimum also makes a viewport-fitting table impossible with 11 columns.

critique.good: Population values and prefecture names remain whole, year headings form legible two-line groups, and the first viewport shows the identifiers and two recent years. The regular row and column structure supports comparison.
critique.problems: Prefecture codes sit above names, making most rows two lines high. The wide table requires substantial scrolling, and the identifiers leave the viewport when reading older years.
critique.cause: The 83 px prefecture column wraps code and name; the 107–117 px year columns preserve values and headings but accumulate width across nine years. Column widths alone cannot keep identifiers visible while scrolling.

critique.good: Rank, prefecture names, and population values remain intact. Equal year widths establish a consistent comparison rhythm.
critique.problems: Several era labels break awkwardly onto a third line, making the entire header unnecessarily tall. The first viewport cuts through 2020 values, and the prefecture column has unused space.
critique.cause: The 107px year columns are too narrow for several complete parenthesized era labels; the 112px prefecture column pushes the second year beyond the viewport.

critique.good: The compact identifier columns allow two complete years to appear initially, while prefecture names and population values remain readable.
critique.problems: The rank heading splits between its two characters. Several era labels also split across three lines, creating an uneven, excessively tall header.
critique.cause: The 38px rank column leaves too little content width for 順位; 107px is insufficient for the longer era labels.

critique.good: All headings fit in two lines, population values remain intact, and two complete years are visible initially. The compact prefecture column preserves names while reducing horizontal travel.
critique.problems: The code and prefecture name occupy separate lines, making body rows tall; scrolling to older years also takes the identifiers off screen. The slight year-width variation is visible but justified by the headings.
critique.cause: The 83px prefecture column cannot fit code and name together; the table necessarily extends well beyond the viewport, and widths alone cannot keep identifiers visible while scrolling.

critique.good: 人口値と都道府県名は分断されず、年列の幅も揃っている。初期画面では順位、地域、直近2年を比較できる。
critique.problems: すべての年見出しが3行になり、元号年の末尾が孤立する。地域コードと名称が2行になり、各都道府県の行も高い。
critique.cause: 年列の106pxは人口値には足りるが、括弧付き元号年を一行に収めるには不足する。地域列の83pxではコードと名称が同じ行に収まらない。

critique.good: 多くの年列が初期画面に現れ、列の存在を把握できる。
critique.problems: 人口値と年見出しが細かく分断され、地域名も割れるため、検索や比較が著しく難しい。表は極端に縦長で、それでも右端の列はスクロールが必要。
critique.cause: 年列38pxではパディングを除いた文字領域が17pxしかない。地域列52pxも名称を保つには狭い。

critique.good: 人口値、地域名、西暦と元号年の各まとまりが保たれ、見出しは2行に揃う。初期画面で直近2年を地域とともに比較でき、全体も整然としている。
critique.problems: コードと地域名が別行になり、都道府県の行に余白が多い。古い年を見るには大きく横スクロールする必要があり、その際に地域の識別が難しくなる。
critique.cause: 地域列83pxではコードと名称が同じ行に収まらない。年列は見出しと値を保つため107〜117px必要で、表全体が広くなる。

critique.good: All columns can be seen together in the full render, and the narrow rank column keeps ranks identifiable.
critique.problems: Headers, prefecture names and population figures fragment across many lines. The resulting tall rows make lookup and comparison extremely difficult, while the table still requires horizontal scrolling.
critique.cause: The 38px year columns leave only 17px for text; the 60px region column also breaks some prefecture names.

critique.good: Population figures and prefecture names remain whole. The two-line year headings and consistent row rhythm support lookup and comparison; the initial viewport shows two recent years alongside the identifiers.
critique.problems: Comparing distant years requires substantial horizontal scrolling, and the viewport cuts into the next year column. Identifiers may leave view during that scroll.
critique.cause: The 107–117px year columns preserve the widest values but produce a 1145px table; the 83px region column places codes and names on separate lines.

critique.good: The narrower table exposes part of a third year initially and reduces the scrolling distance compared with B.
critique.problems: The national totals and some Tokyo values split across lines; era headings split awkwardly, and 神奈川県 breaks. These disruptions especially impair reading the national comparison row.
critique.cause: The 95px year columns leave 74px for text, less than the widest population values and year units. The 70px region and 45px rank columns also split their headings or names.

critique.good: 順位、地域名、人口を読める大きさで保ち、初期画面に2025年と2020年の値をほぼ収めている。人口値の途中での分割もない。
critique.problems: 複数の元号表記が3行に分かれ、見出しが高く不揃いに見える。地域列にも余白が多い。
critique.cause: 年次列の107pxは一部の元号表記には不足し、地域列の98pxは名称を収めるのに必要な幅より広い。

critique.good: 初期画面で多くの年次列の位置を見渡せる。
critique.problems: 人口、年表記、都道府県名が細かく分割され、照合や比較が困難。行も非常に高い。それでも全幅は画面に収まらない。
critique.cause: 年次列38pxでは数字を数文字ずつしか置けず、地域列55pxでは長い都道府県名が分割される。最低幅への調整後の全幅は450px。

critique.good: 人口と地域名が分割されず、年見出しも西暦と元号の2行に整う。初期画面で順位、地域、直近2年を読め、全体の行間と列間も落ち着いている。
critique.problems: 初期画面の右端に2015年列のごく一部が現れる。過去年を読むには横スクロールが必要。
critique.cause: 先頭4列の合計が349pxで、360pxの画面に次列の一部が入る。各年の表記を保つ幅を確保すると、表全体は1145pxになる。

critique.good: 多くの年次列が初期画面に入り、順位と地域を左端から追える。
critique.problems: 年表記、人口の数字、都道府県名が細かく分断され、行が極端に高い。数値の読み取りや年次比較が難しく、さらに横スクロールも必要になる。
critique.cause: 年次列の38pxでは数字や年表記を収められず、地域列の45pxでも名称が分割される。

critique.good: 人口値と都道府県名が分割されず、年見出しも西暦と元号のまとまりで読める。初期画面では地域と直近2年を比較できる。

d1r0B.why: Prefecture names and population figures remain whole, and year headers break naturally. The first viewport shows the labels and two recent years, though comparing older years requires substantial horizontal scrolling.

ref_equal.why: Headers, names and population figures fragment into narrow stacks of characters. Tall rows make lookup and comparison extremely difficult, yet the table still requires horizontal scrolling.

s2B.why: Whole figures and names, clear year groupings and consistent rows support reading. The first viewport contains the labels and two recent years; older-year comparisons still require substantial scrolling.

contrast.why: The wider prefecture column helps somewhat, but names still break and the population figures and year headers remain fragmented into character stacks. Lookup is very difficult and horizontal scrolling is still needed.

ref_auto.why: Population figures stay on one line, but prefecture names stack character by character and era labels break awkwardly. The narrow label columns produce tall, sparse rows and hinder locating places.

acceptance.unsure: A and C are effectively tied: C gives the first two year columns slightly more space, while A is slightly narrower. All five layouts scroll; no fitting layout is supplied to judge or select.
